author: Elastic
description: 检测Windows从可疑目录侧载未签名DLL。对应需求：防御规避。官方：Unsigned DLL Side-Loading from a Suspicious Folder。
name: 【默认】Windows从可疑目录侧载未签名DLL
note:
## 调查指引

### 规则说明
Windows从可疑目录侧载未签名DLL

### 为何重要
绕过防护、伪装或擦痕

### 调查步骤
1. 核对进程名、命令行、父进程、用户与事件ID。
2. 核对路径、注册表、外连地址与是否符合变更窗口。
3. 关联同主机前后同类告警、落地文件与凭据操作。

### 常见误报
- 合法变更窗口内的运维、软件分发或安全工具

### 响应建议
1. 确认是否授权与变更窗口。
2. 无授权则隔离主机、终止可疑进程并排查落地文件与账号。
3. 按主机与用户关联前后同类告警与外连。
setup:
## 设置说明

1. 目标 Windows 主机安装 Elastic Agent，启用 **Elastic Defend**（按规则需要进程/网络/文件/注册表或安全日志）。
2. 确认相关数据流有数据后再评估告警。
tags: 对应需求: 防御规避
query:
library where host.os.type == "windows" and

 process.code_signature.trusted == true and

 (dll.Ext.relative_file_creation_time <= 500 or dll.Ext.relative_file_name_modify_time <= 500) and

  not dll.code_signature.status : ("trusted", "errorExpired", "errorCode_endpoint*", "errorChaining") and

      /* Suspicious Paths */
      dll.path : ("?:\\PerfLogs\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Users\\*\\Pictures\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Users\\*\\Music\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Users\\Public\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Users\\*\\Documents\\*.dll",
				  "?:\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Tasks\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Intel\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\AMD\\Temp\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\AppReadiness\\*.dll",

                  "?:\\Windows\\security\\*.dll",

                  "?:\\Windows\\Setup\\*.dll",

                  "?:\\Windows\\SKB\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Vss\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Web\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\servicing\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\CbsTemp\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Logs\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\WaaS\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\twain_32\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\ShellExperiences\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\ShellComponents\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\PLA\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Migration\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\debug\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Cursors\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Containers\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\Boot\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\bcastdvr\\*.dll",
                  "?:\\Windows\\TextInput\\*.dll",

                  "?:\\Windows\\SchCache\\*.dll",

                  "?:\\Windows\\rescache\\*.dll",

	 /* DLL loaded from the process.executable current directory */
	 (endswith~(substring(dll.path, 0, length(dll.path) - (length(dll.name) + 1)), substring(process.executable, 0, length(process.executable) - (length(process.name) + 1))) or dll.name : "chrome_elf.dll")
